title: Kiša u Bosni, sunce u Hercegovini
Rain in Bosnia, sun in Herzegovina
body: U Bosni i Hercegovini danas pada kiša.
Today it is raining in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Kiša će padati i sutra.
It will rain tomorrow too.
Na planinama može pasti malo snijega.
A little snow may fall in the mountains.
Od srijede će u Hercegovini biti sunčano.
From Wednesday it will be sunny in Herzegovina.
U petak ujutro će biti hladno.
On Friday morning it will be cold.
Temperatura može pasti na minus dva stepena.
The temperature can drop to minus two degrees.

title: Lažno upozorenje na telefonima u Ukrajini i Rusiji
A false warning on phones in Ukraine and Russia
body: U nedjelju navečer milioni ljudi dobili su poruku na telefonu.
On Sunday evening millions of people got a message on their phones.
Poruka je bila upozorenje na nuklearni napad.
The message was a warning about a nuclear attack.
Ali upozorenje nije bilo istinito.
But the warning was not true.
Neko je hakovao ukrajinsku aplikaciju za uzbune.
Someone hacked the Ukrainian app for alerts.
Kasnije je i Rusija rekla da je njena aplikacija napadnuta.
Later Russia also said that its app was attacked.

title: Dončić dao 45 poena protiv Toronta
Dončić scored 45 points against Toronto
body: Luka Dončić igra košarku za Los Angeles Lakerse.
Luka Dončić plays basketball for the Los Angeles Lakers.
Lakersi su pobijedili Toronto rezultatom 131:125.
The Lakers beat Toronto 131:125.
Dončić je dao 45 poena.
Dončić scored 45 points.
Imao je i 15 skokova, šest asistencija i pet ukradenih lopti.
He also had 15 rebounds, six assists and five steals.
Postavio je i novi rekord.
He also set a new record.

title: Messi donio pobjedu Inter Miamiju
Messi brought Inter Miami a win
body: Inter Miami je igrao protiv New Englanda.
Inter Miami played against New England.
New England je prvo vodio.
New England was ahead at first.
Na kraju je Inter Miami pobijedio rezultatom 2:1.
In the end Inter Miami won 2:1.
Lionel Messi je dao jedan gol.
Lionel Messi scored one goal.
Imao je i jednu asistenciju.
He also had one assist.
Zbog ove pobjede tim iduće godine igra na velikom takmičenju.
Because of this win, the team plays in a big competition next year.

title: Novi Xiaomi telefoni stižu u cijeli svijet
New Xiaomi phones are coming to the whole world
body: Xiaomi ima dva nova telefona.
Xiaomi has two new phones.
Zovu se Xiaomi 18 Pro i 18 Pro Max.
They are called Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max.
Telefoni su u Kini od septembra.
The phones have been in China since September.
Ovog mjeseca stižu i u druge zemlje.
This month they are also coming to other countries.
Ljudi ih uskoro mogu kupiti i izvan Kine.
People can soon buy them outside China too.

title: Ryanair zaradio manje novca
Ryanair earned less money
body: Ryanair je velika avio-kompanija iz Irske.
Ryanair is a big airline from Ireland.
Kompanija je zaradila 2,15 milijardi eura.
The company earned 2.15 billion euros.
To je dobit za šest mjeseci, do kraja septembra.
That is the profit for six months, up to the end of September.
Prošle godine dobit je bila 2,54 milijarde eura.
Last year the profit was 2.54 billion euros.
Dobit je pala za 15 posto.
The profit fell by 15 percent.

title: Ukrajinac oborio Guinnessov rekord na televiziji
A Ukrainian broke a Guinness record on TV
body: Supertalent je hrvatska televizijska emisija.
Supertalent is a Croatian TV show.
U emisiji je nastupio Oleksandr Saša Khoruzenko iz Ukrajine.
Oleksandr Saša Khoruzenko from Ukraine performed on the show.
On se vrti u velikom metalnom točku.
He spins inside a big metal wheel.
Za 30 sekundi napravio je 56 okreta.
In 30 seconds he made 56 turns.
Stari Guinnessov rekord bio je 49 okreta.
The old Guinness record was 49 turns.
Članica žirija Maja Šuput uporedila ga je s Aladinom.
Jury member Maja Šuput compared him to Aladdin.
